scenario: Synthetic 256 MiB HTTP 200 body ignoring Range, streamed into a native OPFS file writer in a fresh isolated browser.
limitations: Sampled aggregate browser-process RSS can count shared or mapped pages more than once and varies with garbage collection.
This is a controlled whole-response case, not a universal memory limit or a measurement of a signed-in Telegram page.
Backing storage is the Chrome DevTools Runtime.getHeapUsage metric, separate from ordinary JavaScript heap.
